answer: To join, an agent must keep a haven for a season, logging every traveler it shelters in a register that two neighbors countersign weekly, with each entry passing a prism check that splits a stay into arrival, service, and departure records that match. A whisper network of guests may flag an entry within ten days, and the keeper audits flagged entries against tickets. A copied register, an unmatched split, or a second claim on a haven voids the season, revokes linked identities, and bars its sponsor for a year. One honest haven costs a season; faking a thousand needs a thousand havens at once.
